retrieved_chunks.text: Ask for the order ID, then ask for **one** of: the last 4 digits of the registered phone number, or the delivery pincode for that order. Compare with the `phone_last4` or `delivery_pincode` fields from order lookup.

| Status shown | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| Placed | Payment confirmed, waiting to be packed |
| Packed | Packed at the warehouse, waiting for courier pickup |
| Shipped | With the courier, on the way |
| Out for delivery | With the delivery executive today |
| Delivery attempted | The courier could not deliver; see DEL-3 |
| Delivered | Handed over at the address |
| Returned to origin (RTO) | Could not be delivered and is going back to the warehouse; prepaid refunds follow REF-1 |
| Cancelled | Cancelled before shipping |
If an order shows Delivered but the customer has not received it, check with family, neighbours or the building security, then report it within 48 hours as a missing item under DWM-1.

A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can:
- refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or
- accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable.

Any order can be cancelled free of charge until it is shipped, by the customer from My Orders in the app. The support assistant cannot cancel orders itself; it guides the customer to My Orders. The refund is initiated immediately.
Allow one retry. If it fails again, do not share order details. Offer general policy help and suggest the customer contact support from the registered phone number.

The courier makes up to 3 delivery attempts. After a failed attempt the customer gets an SMS to reschedule. If the third attempt fails, the parcel is returned to the warehouse (return to origin, RTO) and REF-1 applies.

- **Cancelled before shipping:** immediately on cancellation.
- **Returned item:** after the item passes quality check, within 2 business days of pickup. ZentroMart Plus members: at pickup.
- **Prepaid order refused at the door or not delivered after 3 attempts:** once the parcel reaches the warehouse, usually 7 to 10 calendar days after the last delivery attempt.
